description: This source file defines the BOMNode class, which models a node in a Bill of Materials (BOM) tree for manufacturing processes. It includes methods for loading child and parent nodes, handling substitutions based on rules, generating manufacturing orders, and various utility functions related to BOM structures.

classes.name: BOMNode
classes.description: Represents a node in the Bill of Materials (BOM) tree, including manufacturing, substitution, and configuration logic. Provides methods for loading hierarchy, creating manufacturing orders, and handling product substitutions.

methods.name: BOMNode
methods.description: Constructor initializing a BOMNode with a product GenericValue, dispatcher, and user login context.

methods.name: loadChildren
methods.description: Loads child nodes from ProductAssoc entities based on type, date, and product features.

methods.name: substituteNode
methods.description: Performs substitution of a BOM child node based on manufacturing rules and product features.

methods.name: configurator
methods.description: Creates and configures a new BOMNode, applying rules and substitutions, based on product features and in-date rules.

methods.name: loadParents
methods.description: Loads parent nodes related to this node via ProductAssoc entities.

methods.name: getParentNode
methods.description: Returns the parent node in the BOM tree.

methods.name: getRootNode
methods.description: Returns the root node of the BOM tree.

methods.name: setParentNode
methods.description: Sets the parent node.

methods.name: print
methods.description: Recursively prints the BOM tree structure with quantities and depths.

methods.name: print
methods.description: Adds nodes to an array for display, including service-based quantities.

methods.name: getProductsInPackages
methods.description: Collects BOM nodes representing products in packaging.

methods.name: sumQuantity
methods.description: Aggregates quantities from a subtree into a map of nodes.

methods.name: createManufacturingOrder
methods.description: Generates manufacturing order data, including production runs, based on BOM structure and parameters.

methods.name: getStartDate
methods.description: Calculates the earliest start date for manufacturing, considering child nodes.

methods.name: isWarehouseManaged
methods.description: Checks whether product is managed in a warehouse based on product facilities and product type.

methods.name: isManufactured
methods.description: Determines if the node is considered manufactured based on child nodes and supplier product availability.

methods.name: isVirtual
methods.description: Returns true if the product is marked as virtual.

methods.name: isConfigured
methods.description: Recursively gathers configured nodes.

methods.name: getQuantity
methods.description: Returns the current quantity value.

methods.name: setQuantity
methods.description: Sets the quantity value.

methods.name: getDepth
methods.description: Returns the depth of the node in the BOM tree.

methods.name: getProduct
methods.description: Returns the product GenericValue associated with this node.

methods.name: getSubstitutedNode
methods.description: Returns the substituted node, if any.

methods.name: setSubstitutedNode
methods.description: Sets the substituted node.

methods.name: getRootProductForRules
methods.description: Returns the root product for rule evaluation.

methods.name: getProductForRules
methods.description: Returns the product identifier for rule processing.

methods.name: setProductForRules
methods.description: Sets the product identifier for rule processing.

methods.name: getBomTypeId
methods.description: Returns the BOM type identifier.

methods.name: getQuantityMultiplier
methods.description: Returns the quantity multiplier.

methods.name: setQuantityMultiplier
methods.description: Sets the quantity multiplier.

methods.name: getRuleApplied
methods.description: Returns the rule applied to this node.

methods.name: setRuleApplied
methods.description: Sets the rule applied.

methods.name: getScrapFactor
methods.description: Returns the scrap factor.

methods.name: setScrapFactor
methods.description: Sets the scrap factor.

methods.name: getChildrenNodes
methods.description: Returns the list of child BOMNode objects.

methods.name: setChildrenNodes
methods.description: Sets the list of child BOMNode objects.

methods.name: getProductAssoc
methods.description: Returns associated entity value for product association.

methods.name: setProductAssoc
methods.description: Sets the associated entity value for product.

methods.name: setTree
methods.description: Associates a BOMTree with this node.

methods.name: getTree
methods.description: Gets the BOMTree associated with this node.
